user.title: Druckwerk bridge
user.description: Address of the Druckwerk bridge API.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on at this URL.

print_file.name: Print file
print_file.description: Sends a .gcode.3mf file to a printer as a cloud print through the add-on.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: Printer device, as registered by the printer integration.

serial.name: Serial
serial.description: Printer serial number, used when no device is given.

file.name: File
file.description: Path relative to /media/druckwerk, or an absolute path under /media or /share.

bed_leveling.name: Bed leveling
bed_leveling.description: Level the bed before printing: on, off or auto (the printer decides).

force.name: Force
force.description: Send even if the printer is running or paused.

flow_cali.name: Flow dynamics calibration
flow_cali.description: Calibrate the flow before printing: on, off or auto. Left out, the bridge keeps its default (on).

vibration_cali.name: Vibration calibration
vibration_cali.description: Run the vibration (resonance) calibration. Left out, the bridge keeps its default (on).

layer_inspect.name: First layer inspection
layer_inspect.description: Inspect the first layer with the printer camera. Left out: off.

nozzle_offset_cali.name: Nozzle offset calibration
nozzle_offset_cali.description: Calibrate the nozzle offset: on, off or auto. For printers with two nozzles. Left out: off.

bed_type.name: Plate type
bed_type.description: The build plate in the printer. auto means the file decides. Left out: auto.

ext_change_assist.name: External spool change assist
ext_change_assist.description: Let the printer help when you change the external spool. Left out: off.

init.title: Druckwerk
init.description: Upload secret: agents upload sliced files with PUT /api/druckwerk/upload/<name>.gcode.3mf and the header X-Druckwerk-Secret (empty turns uploads off). Hub secret: normally set by app discovery; paste it here otherwise (empty keeps the current one). Recipients: YAML map of person entity to notify service, e.g. person.anna: notify.mobile_app_anna; they are notified only while at home.

error.invalid_hub_secret: The hub rejected this secret or is not reachable.

integration_too_old.title: Update the Druckwerk integration
integration_too_old.description: The Druckwerk app speaks a newer interface than this integration. Update the Druckwerk integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant.

app_too_old.title: Update the Druckwerk app
app_too_old.description: The Druckwerk app is too old to offer actions and tools. Update the Druckwerk app.
